about_the_game:
FLOW is a laid-back drift racing experience designed for pure enjoyment and flow. Slide into a relaxing world where style matters more than speed and every drift feels smooth and satisfying.

Core Gameplay

Immerse yourself in the zen of drifting through a friendly two-phase system that encourages experimentation and fun. Each level lets you experience the joy twice - first as the lead driver creating beautiful drift lines while AI companions follow your flow, then switching perspectives as you cruise behind the AI and focus on your own smooth techniques.

Start your journey with a single car and let your natural drifting instincts guide you through progressively more interesting tracks. Every smooth slide and graceful turn adds to your score in a stress-free environment where the focus is on finding your rhythm rather than perfect precision. Hit the level's target score at your own pace to unlock new scenic routes and earn rewards.

Progression & Customization

Transform your garage from humble beginnings into a showcase of drift legends. Spend earned money on new cars, each with unique handling characteristics. Dive deep into customization with a parts system featuring upgrades that let you craft your perfect drift machine. From spoilers and body kits to rims and paint jobs, every modification is applied in your personal garage.

Key Features

  • Relaxed Dual-Phase Racing: Lead and follow

  • Forgiving Physics: Smooth, accessible drifting with no harsh penalties

  • Gentle Progression: Unlock tracks at your own comfortable pace

  • Extensive Car Collection: Discover and collect vehicles that suit your style

  • Creative Customization: Express yourself with countless upgrades

  • Peaceful Garage: Modify your cars in a calming, pressure-free space

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GT 1030 / AMD Radeon RX 550
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400F / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 / RTX 3050 / AMD RX 6500 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
